_doc: 14 §6 — schema <-> data pairing overrides for build/ci/Invoke-ContentValidation.ps1.
_comment_map: 'map' is deliberately ABSENT. The convention in Invoke-ContentValidation.ps1 —
— matches every file M0-10 authored, so there is nothing to override. Add 'map'
only when a real pairing cannot be expressed by the convention, never to silence
an orphan: a data file with no schema is exactly the failure 14 §6 exists to catch.
_comment_pendingData: Schemas whose DATA has not been authored yet. C1 requires the full schema to ship
in the client, and 26 §2 names schema/event.schema.json explicitly, so authoring a
schema ahead of its content is correct and expected — the orphan check's 'the schema
outlived its content' reading is the wrong one here.
Each entry names the milestone task that authors the data. The check FAILS if a
listed schema has since gained data (a stale exemption is a lie), so an entry cannot
outlive its milestone. Same discipline as build/ci/test-suites.json's knownEmpty.

schema/chapter.schema.json.reason: The 8 chapter data files (weights, pools, targets, unlock conditions) are authored with the board and run loop. 14 §6's worked example is a chapter definition, so the schema is written first on purpose.

schema/event.schema.json.reason: Per-event live-ops packages (EVT_EMBERFALL first) land with the events framework. 26 §2 requires the package schema to be build-time validated and shipped in the client before any event exists, so that no app update is needed to run one. NOTE: distinct from schema/events.schema.json, which governs the framework tunables in tuning/events.json.
